focus: Unread releases for the advisor: surfaceHint schema bounds and plugin marker logic (v4.0.0.6), doctor-command suggestions on three release-note prompts (v4.0.0.12, v4.0.1.0), and where doctor routing lives plus its coverage of .skilled/commands/doctor

label: Drift + operator UX: v4.0.1.0 claims the advisor 'suggests the new doctor commands when a prompt describes their problem', but 'my hooks are not firing, what do I run' returns no doctor command in the top three — cli-external-orchestration 0.128817, mcp-code-mode 0.109385, cli-classifier 0.093333, ambiguous true. The second early return in applyDoctorHelperHandoff (`if (skillPasses && cue !== 'strong') return [...ranked]`) lets any non-doctor skill that merely passes threshold suppress the /doctor:helper hand-off, so a 0.13 lexical residue outranks the /doctor:skill-advisor or /doctor:runtime-mirrors answer the operator actually needs

Drift, README vs schema: system-skill-advisor/README.md names seven advisor_recommend options bare (topK, includeCompiledRoute, surfaceHint) but the schema accepts them only nested under `options`, so the documented call fails with exit 64 'Unknown parameter(s): topK' and 'Unknown parameter(s): includeCompiledRoute'. The README never shows the nesting and no alias exists, so an operator or agent hand-building the documented call hits a hard failure with no hint

Drift risk, doctor routing is duplicated across a generated table and the scorer projection: DOCTOR_COMMAND_STRINGS (35 entries, BEGIN GENERATED DOCTOR COMMANDS) in render.ts, hand-projected doctor entries in scorer/projection.ts, and isDoctorBridgeId's prefix test which makes any command-doctor-* id render as a command. Coverage is currently complete for all 17 files under .skilled/commands/doctor/, and doctorCommandString returns null for an unmapped doctor id so a forgotten regeneration renders nothing rather than the id — a silent drop, not a visible error

advisor_recommend enforces surfaceHint bounds of 1 to 64 characters end to end: empty string yields 'must be at least 1 character(s)', 65 characters yields 'must be at most 64 character(s)', both exit 64, and the OpenCode plugin omits the hint entirely when detection returns null. The v4.0.0.6 release claim is accurate as written

The doctor command surface is fully enumerated from disk: all 17 files under .skilled/commands/doctor/ (agents-md, ci, deep-loop, env, git, helper, install, mcp, overlay, runtime-mirrors, setup, sk-code, sk-skill, skill-advisor, speckit, symlink, update) map into the 35-entry generated DOCTOR_COMMAND_STRINGS table, so no doctor command is orphaned from the render path
Do the unread advisor release claims (surfaceHint, doctor suggestions) hold against the code?
Hook problem-words reach no doctor command
README option names rejected at top level
